title: The Ages of Steam
description: Create Modpack. Featuring Create 6.0, Create Steam 'n' Rails, Create Aeronautics and many more Create Addons.
body:
Step into the Steampunk Age and experience modded Minecraft like never before. Powered by the Create 6.0 update, this modpack takes you on an incredible engineering journey where the sky is literally the limit. Build sprawling train networks, construct magnificent airships, and automate your entire world!

Featuring:

- Create 6.0

- Create: Aeronautics

- Create: Steam 'n' Rails

- many more Create Addons
